stages.name: Gains and risks of trade
stages.title: Gains and risks of trade
stages.sub: Weigh up what countries gain and risk when they specialise and trade with each other.

steps.q: Vietnam specialises in trainers, Italy in coffee machines, and they trade. What can shoppers in both countries now buy?
steps.right: A wider range of goods from both countries
steps.wrong: Exactly the same range as before, just cheaper
steps.hint: Think about how many more products are on the shelves once each country brings its own specialities to trade.

steps.right: Many struggle to find work in their old trade
steps.wrong: They easily move straight into any other job

steps.q: Italy buys trainers priced in Vietnamese dong. If the dong suddenly becomes much dearer against the euro, what happens to Italy's cost?
steps.right: It rises sharply, even though nothing changed at home
steps.wrong: It stays the same, since trainers themselves did not change
steps.hint: Italy has no alternative supplier at home. What happens when the exchange rate it depends on moves against it?
